blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — As Filipino consumers prepare for Undas and the Christmas and New Year holidays, the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) said prices of 190 monitored basic necessities and prime commodities will not increase until Dec. 31, 2026, assuring the public that supplies of the listed products remain sufficient nationwide. In a statement on Monday, Oct. 26, the DTI said the commitment covers only the essential food and non-food items included in its official Suggested Retail Price (SRP) bulletin.
